The northern and northeastern areas are marked “winter,” a relatively large range in the central and eastern parts is marked “autumn,” and the South China coast and the vicinity of Hainan are marked “summer.” Overall, it shows that the seasons gradually become warmer from north to south. Reasoning: The question stem states that this is the situation on the same day, November 7, 2009, the Beginning of Winter, so the time condition is the same. China has a large north-south span, and the latitude differences are obvious; the higher the latitude, the smaller the solar altitude, the less solar radiation received, the lower the temperature, and the easier it is to enter winter; the lower the latitude, the better the heat conditions, and the south may still be in summer. Therefore, the main reason that winter, autumn, and summer appear on the same day is that the latitude differences among various places are large.
